name: grade-tracker
description: ConnectUs (connectusonline.org) — static site + Firebase. Prod: school-grade-tracker (main). Dev: dev-school-grade-tracker (dev).

scripts.deploy:dev: npm run guard:dev && npm run config:check && firebase deploy --project dev --non-interactive
scripts.deploy:dev:rules: npm run guard:dev && firebase deploy --project dev --only firestore,storage,database --non-interactive
scripts.deploy:dev:functions: npm run guard:dev && firebase deploy --project dev --only functions --non-interactive
scripts.deploy:dev:hosting: npm run guard:dev && npm run config:check && firebase deploy --project dev --only hosting --non-interactive
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run guard:prod && npm run config:check && firebase deploy --project prod --only firestore,storage,database,functions --non-interactive
scripts.deploy:prod:rules: npm run guard:prod && firebase deploy --project prod --only firestore,storage,database --non-interactive
scripts.deploy:prod:functions: npm run guard:prod && firebase deploy --project prod --only functions --non-interactive
scripts.deploy:prod:hosting: npm run guard:prod && npm run config:check && firebase deploy --project prod --only hosting --non-interactive
